en.title: Robot CLI - Help
body: Robot CLI is an interactive tool for managing
the Nerthus game world. Here you will find everything
you need: sessions, characters, NPCs, locations, groups,
q/Esc     go back (in main menu: exit)
The main menu contains 7 thematic categories.
Select a category to see available operations.
Operations without a marker are available to everyone.
Refresh data — reload information about characters,
players and game world elements. Useful when data
has been changed outside this tool.

Przeglądaj sesje       Lista sesji z filtrem dat.
